page_title: ATA 0-1 JUV | Atalanta v Juventus 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) will take a corner kick.
86' Davide Zappacosta will be replaced by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
85' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.
84' Filip Kostic (Juventus) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
84' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) tackles a bit over-zealously and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul. Atalanta win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
81' The corner kick from Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
80' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Atalanta have a corner.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso will be replaced by Filip Kostic (Juventus).
79' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Francisco Conceicao will be replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
79' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
76' 16:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
73' Today's referee Fabio Maresca rightly decides to book Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) for his harsh tackle.
72' Here is a change. Nikola Krstovic is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
72' It is time for a substitution. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is on for Marten de Roon.
72' Sead Kolasinac goes off the pitch and Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) comes on.
71' A cross from a corner kick by Atalanta is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
71' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) replaces Khephren Thuram.
71' Substitution. Emil Holm makes way for Federico Gatti (Juventus).
69' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Khephren Thuram (Juventus), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

67' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is free in the box and Emil Holm finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
66' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
64' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fabio Maresca saw the whole situation. A free kick to Juventus.
63' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Michele Di Gregorio is alert to thwart the effort.
63' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
61' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.

59' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Michele Di Gregorio sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
58' Substitution. Jonathan David (Juventus) in, Kenan Yildiz out.
58' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

56' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) meets a nice cross deep inside the 18-yard box and produces a fine header towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is well positioned and punches the ball away, deflecting it onto the post.
56' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
56' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus).
55' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
55' That will be all from Nicola Zalewski who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).
54' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

52' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Fabio Maresca has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
51' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Jeremie Boga, but Marco Carnesecchi displays great awareness to stop him.

50' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Jeremie Boga (Juventus) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:1.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A rebound spins to Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
45+3' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45+3' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Bremer (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' The game is interrupted now, Bremer (Juventus) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Dangerous play by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta). Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
40' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
39' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
38' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
37' A raking crossfield pass from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
34' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
32' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

30' Wasted opportunity! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
27' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

26' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
24' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for an infringement.
22' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
21' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
19' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes it short.
13' Juventus control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

9' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) shows good timing as he latches on to a perfect lofted pass into the box. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and glances off the right-hand post.
8' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call. Atalanta will take a free kick.

7' Close! Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
4' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Michele Di Gregorio.
3' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
1' The match has just started.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Fabio Maresca will referee today's match.
